note: DEVELOPMENT / REGRESSION DATA ONLY. Everything in this file is visible to implementation and was used for tuning (HO1-HO3 since p2r3a; chains, b144FollowUps and matrixDev authored for V2-2C C3). Never cite results on it as unbiased accuracy. Held-out data (Held-Out #4 and the external held-out phrasing templates) is NEVER stored here: it is authored independently outside the repo and read only through tests/vero-v2-shadow.js --holdout <path> (V2-2D).

cls: Each turn declares its follow-up class (STANDALONE / CONTEXT / CONTEXT_COMPAT / TOPIC_SWITCH / STANDALONE_IN_SEQ). The harness derives the class independently (sequence position, contextTurns, topicSwitch, gold route) and fails on any mismatch; the declared label never overrides the derived one.
